questions.answer_as: আভা চহৰৰ ওচৰত ইৰাৱদী নদীৰ পাৰত।

questions.question_en: On which river is Yandabo located?

questions.question_en: How many rupees is one crore?

questions.question_en: Which two territories did Burma give up all claims on under the treaty?

questions.answer_en: Cachar and Jaintia.

questions.question_en: What did Burma agree to regarding the British envoy at Ava?

questions.question_en: In which year did Assam come under the rule of the British East India Company?

questions.question_en: Who was appointed the first British Agent of Assam?

questions.question_en: What was the later official title of David Scott in Assam?

questions.question_en: When did the British take over the administration of Upper Assam?

questions.answer_en: Later than Lower Assam, after 1828.

questions.question_en: Who was restored as the tributary king of Upper Assam in 1833?
questions.question_as: ১৮৩৩ চনত উজনি অসমৰ শ্ৰদ্ধেয় (সামন্ত) ৰজা হিচাপে কোন পুনৰ স্থাপিত হৈছিল?
questions.answer_en: Purandar Singha.

questions.question_en: When was Purandar Singha deposed by the British?
questions.question_as: ব্ৰিটিছসকলে পুৰন্দৰ সিংহক কেতিয়া পদচ্যুত কৰিছিল?

questions.question_en: Why was Purandar Singha deposed in 1838?
questions.question_as: ১৮৩৮ চনত পুৰন্দৰ সিংহক কিয় পদচ্যুত কৰা হৈছিল?
questions.answer_en: For failing to pay the tribute.
questions.answer_as: ৰাজসোণ (কৰ) পৰিশোধ কৰাত ব্যৰ্থ হোৱা বাবে।

questions.question_en: Which royal dynasty came to an end with the deposition of Purandar Singha in 1838?
questions.question_as: ১৮৩৮ চনত পুৰন্দৰ সিংহক পদচ্যুত কৰাত কোন ৰাজবংশৰ সমাপ্তি ঘটিল?

questions.question_en: Assam was initially a part of which Presidency?

questions.answer_en: The Bengal Presidency.

questions.question_en: What was the capital of Assam when it was made a separate province in 1874?

questions.answer_en: Shillong.

questions.question_en: Who was the first Chief Commissioner of Assam?
questions.question_as: অসমৰ প্ৰথম মুখ্য আয়ুক্ত কোন আছিল?
questions.answer_en: Colonel R.H. Keatinge.

questions.question_en: In which year was Cachar annexed by the British?
questions.question_as: ব্ৰিটিছসকলে কাছাৰ কোন চনত অধিগ্ৰহণ কৰিছিল?

questions.question_en: In which year was Jaintia annexed by the British?
questions.question_as: ব্ৰিটিছসকলে জয়ন্তীয়া কোন চনত অধিগ্ৰহণ কৰিছিল?

questions.question_en: In which year were the Khasi hills annexed by the British?
questions.question_as: ব্ৰিটিছসকলে খাছি পাহাৰ কোন চনত অধিগ্ৰহণ কৰিছিল?

questions.question_en: Under whose administration were the Khasi hills annexed?
questions.question_as: কোনৰ শাসনকালত খাছি পাহাৰ অধিগৃহীত হৈছিল?
questions.answer_en: David Scott's administration.

questions.question_en: Which war ended with the Treaty of Yandabo?
questions.question_as: য়াণ্ডাবু সন্ধিৰ দ্বাৰা কোন যুদ্ধ সমাপ্ত হৈছিল?
questions.answer_en: The First Anglo-Burmese War.

questions.question_en: Trap: Was the Treaty of Yandabo signed in 1824?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: য়াণ্ডাবু সন্ধি ১৮২৪ চনত স্বাক্ষৰিত হৈছিলনে?

questions.question_en: Trap: Is Yandabo located on the Brahmaputra river?

questions.answer_en: No, it is on the Irrawaddy river.
questions.answer_as: নহয়, ই ইৰাৱদী নদীৰ পাৰত অৱস্থিত।

questions.question_en: Trap: Did Burma pay an indemnity of ten lakh rupees under the treaty?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: সন্ধি অনুসৰি বাৰ্মাই দহ লাখ টকা ক্ষতিপূৰণ দিছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No, the indemnity was one crore rupees.
questions.answer_as: নহয়, ক্ষতিপূৰণ এক কোটি টকা আছিল।

questions.question_en: Trap: Was Purandar Singha deposed by the British in 1833?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: পুৰন্দৰ সিংহক ব্ৰিটিছসকলে ১৮৩৩ চনত পদচ্যুত কৰিছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No, in 1833 he was restored; he was deposed in 1838.
questions.answer_as: নহয়, ১৮৩৩ চনত তেওঁ পুনৰ স্থাপিত হৈছিল; ১৮৩৮ চনত পদচ্যুত হৈছিল।

questions.question_en: Trap: Was David Scott the first Chief Commissioner of Assam?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: ডেভিড স্কট অসমৰ প্ৰথম মুখ্য আয়ুক্ত আছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No, he was the first British Agent; the first Chief Commissioner was Col. R.H. Keatinge.
questions.answer_as: নহয়, তেওঁ প্ৰথম ব্ৰিটিছ এজেণ্ট আছিল; প্ৰথম মুখ্য আয়ুক্ত আছিল কৰ্ণেল আৰ. এইচ. কিটিং।

questions.question_en: Trap: Was Assam initially part of the Madras Presidency?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: অসম প্ৰথমে মাদ্ৰাজ প্ৰেছিডেন্সিৰ অন্তৰ্ভুক্ত আছিলনে?

questions.answer_as: নহয়, ই বেংগল প্ৰেছিডেন্সিৰ অন্তৰ্ভুক্ত আছিল।

questions.question_en: Trap: Was Dispur the capital of Assam when it became a separate province in 1874?

questions.answer_en: No, the capital was Shillong.

questions.question_en: Trap: Was Cachar annexed by the British in 1835?

questions.answer_en: No, Cachar was annexed in 1832.

questions.question_en: Trap: Was Jaintia annexed by the British in 1832?

questions.answer_en: No, Jaintia was annexed in 1835.

questions.question_en: Trap: Were the Khasi hills annexed by the British in 1835?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: ব্ৰিটিছসকলে খাছি পাহাৰ ১৮৩৫ চনত অধিগ্ৰহণ কৰিছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No, the Khasi hills were annexed in 1833.
questions.answer_as: নহয়, খাছি পাহাৰ ১৮৩৩ চনত অধিগৃহীত হৈছিল।

questions.question_en: Trap: Did the Treaty of Yandabo give Manipur to Burma?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: য়াণ্ডাবু সন্ধিয়ে মণিপুৰ বাৰ্মাক দিছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No, Burma ceded Manipur to the British.
questions.answer_as: নহয়, বাৰ্মাই মণিপুৰ ব্ৰিটিছক সমৰ্পণ কৰিছিল।

questions.question_en: Trap: Was the Treaty of Yandabo signed on 24 February 1825?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: য়াণ্ডাবু সন্ধি ১৮২৫ চনৰ ২৪ ফেব্ৰুৱাৰীত স্বাক্ষৰিত হৈছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No, it was signed on 24 February 1826.
questions.answer_as: নহয়, ই ১৮২৬ চনৰ ২৪ ফেব্ৰুৱাৰীত স্বাক্ষৰিত হৈছিল।

questions.question_en: Trap: Was Chandrakanta Singha the king restored as tributary ruler of Upper Assam in 1833?

questions.answer_en: No, it was Purandar Singha.

questions.question_en: Trap: Was Assam made a separate Chief Commissioner's Province in 1874 with its capital at Guwahati?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: ১৮৭৪ চনত অসমক সুকীয়া মুখ্য আয়ুক্ত-শাসিত প্ৰদেশ কৰাত তাৰ ৰাজধানী গুৱাহাটী আছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No, the capital was Shillong.

questions.question_en: Trap: Was the British general who signed the treaty named Sir Edward Paget?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: সন্ধিত স্বাক্ষৰ কৰা ব্ৰিটিছ জেনেৰেল ছাৰ এডৱাৰ্ড পেজেট আছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No, he was Sir Archibald Campbell.
questions.answer_as: নহয়, তেওঁ আছিল ছাৰ আৰ্চিবল্ড কেম্পবেল।

questions.question_en: Trap: Did the treaty require Burma to pay an indemnity of one lakh rupees?
questions.question_as: ফাঁদ: সন্ধিয়ে বাৰ্মাক এক লাখ টকা ক্ষতিপূৰণ দিবলৈ নিৰ্দেশ দিছিলনে?
questions.answer_en: No, the indemnity was one crore rupees.
questions.answer_as: নহয়, ক্ষতিপূৰণ আছিল এক কোটি টকা।

questions.question_en: Besides the indemnity, what diplomatic condition was imposed on Burma?
questions.question_as: ক্ষতিপূৰণৰ উপৰিও বাৰ্মাৰ ওপৰত কি কূটনৈতিক চৰ্ত আৰোপ কৰা হৈছিল?
questions.answer_en: To receive a British envoy at Ava.
questions.answer_as: আভাত এজন ব্ৰিটিছ ৰাজদূত গ্ৰহণ কৰা।

questions.question_en: Who was the first British official to administer the newly acquired territories of Assam after 1826?
questions.question_as: ১৮২৬ চনৰ পিছত অসমৰ নতুন অধিগৃহীত অঞ্চল পৰিচালনা কৰা প্ৰথম ব্ৰিটিছ বিষয়া কোন আছিল?
questions.answer_en: David Scott, the first British Agent of Assam.

questions.question_en: In which sequence did the British take over the administration of Lower and Upper Assam?

questions.answer_en: Lower Assam in 1828, and Upper Assam later.
questions.answer_as: তলৰ অসম ১৮২৮ চনত, আৰু উজনি অসম পিছত।

questions.answer_en: Assam came under the rule of the British East India Company from 1826.

questions.question_en: What did the British grant Purandar Singha in 1833 before deposing him in 1838?
questions.question_as: ১৮৩৮ চনত পদচ্যুত কৰাৰ আগত ১৮৩৩ চনত ব্ৰিটিছসকলে পুৰন্দৰ সিংহক কি দিছিল?
questions.answer_en: Restoration as a tributary king of Upper Assam.
questions.answer_as: উজনি অসমৰ সামন্ত ৰজা হিচাপে পুনৰ স্থাপিত কৰা।
